title: [PDF] Lecture 11 - Reinforcement Learning
description: The value function V π for a policy π measures the expected return if you start in state s and follow policy π. A closely related but usefully different function is the state-action value function, or Q-function, Qπ for policy π, defined as:. is the optimal state-action value function, and we can rewrite the optimal Bellman equation without mentioning π?:. Observe: a fixed point of this update is exactly a solution of the optimal Bellman equation, which we saw characterizes the Q-function of an optimal policy. Learn a value function (e.g. Q-learning, covered in this lecture). The ε-greedy policy ensures that most of the time (probability 1 − ε) the agent exploits its incomplete knowledge of the world by chooses the best action (i.e., corresponding to the highest action-value), but occasionally (probability ε) it explores other actions. Because the fixed-point of the Bellman optimality operator is unique (and is Q∗), Q is the same as the optimal action-value function Q∗.
